sources.title: Open Food Facts JSONL data and licensing
sources.notes: Database ODbL; contents/media terms separate. No full data download; endpoint existence/health must be checked at runtime.

sources.title: Open Food Facts official Parquet distribution
sources.notes: Different transformed schema from raw JSONL. Pin dataset revision and resolved assets; do not assume range filtering avoids all download bytes.

sources.title: Open Food Facts delta exporter
sources.notes: Active product last_modified_t intervals (from,to], bounded recent retention; no general deletion-tombstone guarantee. Surfaced index content was stale/cached, not a successful current live-health check.

sources.title: Open Prices bulk exports
sources.notes: Snapshot exports, ODbL; related files require join/revision checks. Proof image mirroring not required.

sources.title: FoodKeeper official data catalog
sources.notes: Catalog lists JSON/XLS and CC0/irregular updates; runtime resolve safe current URL. Legacy HTTP link is not permission to downgrade TLS.

sources.title: Overture Places and release discovery
sources.notes: Current taxonomy/basic_category replaces older categories. Source-dependent licensing/provenance and overlap with ATP; V1.1 extension.

sources.title: OSM regional data and indoor tooling
sources.notes: V1.1 geometry extension; actual supermarket interior coverage and rights must be measured, not assumed.

sources.title: Scrapy crawling controls
sources.notes: Optional implementation library; adaptive rate control does not replace robots, rights, allowlists or budgets.

sources.title: Kroger official developer interfaces
sources.notes: Current account entitlement, response schema, tariff and retention not tested. Disabled non-core integration; reverify before activation.

sources.title: Walmart developer API distinctions
sources.notes: Supplier/store-service/affiliate contracts are not universal consumer grocery inventory access. Tariffs and account entitlement unverified.

sources.title: Instacart Developer Platform
sources.notes: Retain existing Bòrd shopping handoff. Admission, account entitlement and fee not verified; no marketplace mirror claim.

sources.title: Walmart chain and Coralville dated examples
sources.notes: Examples preserved from supplied files. Store hours/counts are dated facts, not newly fetched production records. Do not copy noncompliant/proxy settings from an upstream crawler.

sources.title: Woodman’s North Aurora store-map link
sources.notes: Observed distinct PDF store-map and geographic map links. No PDF downloaded; no layout currency or reuse permission established.

sources.title: Codex repository guidance
sources.notes: Prompts rely on repository instructions, scoped tasks and test evidence; no specific model, paid feature, agent count or Goal-mode capability is required.
